Brī ir visu iepriekšminēto dāmu pretstats - viņa ģimenes dzīvi rūpīgi organizē, rūpējas par saimniecību, vīru un bērniem. Bet viņa ir tik ļoti pārņemta ar visa organizēšanu, ka iekārei uz seksu nav laika un vietas. Tas kļūst par iemeslu ģimenes konfliktam un ir pilnīgs pretstats kaimiņieņu seksa stāstiņiem. Seriāla laikā visu dāmu dzīves stāsti krustojas, veidojot interesantas un nereti intrigu caurvītas situācijas. Bīstamās mājsaimnieces dzīvo priekšpilsētā, un dzīve tur noris gluži kā Latvijas ciematos un mazpilsētās, kur galvenās aktualitātes ir pašu un kaimiņu dzīves. Seriāls Bīstamās mājsaimnieces pirmās sezonas laikā tika nominēts sešām Emmy, divām Zelta Globusa un divām Kino aktieru ģildes balvām. Felicita Hafmane, kas atveido Linetu, saņēma Emmy balvu kā labākā komēdiju seriālu aktrise. Terija Hačere, kas atveido Sūzanu, saņēma Zelta Globusa un Kino aktieru ģildes balvu. Turpmāko sezonu laikā seriāls Bīstamās mājsaimnieces ticis nominēts un ieguvis daudz un dažādas balvas - par labāko aktieru sastāvu, labāko muzikālo izpildījumu un otrā plāna aktieru piesaisti.

programme.title: Mīlasstāsts: Džons F. Kenedijs jaunākais un Karolīna Besete
Rezidents
programme.desc: Česteinā ierodas jauna ķirurģijas nodaļas interne Līla, gatava priekšzīmīgi veikt savus pienākumus. Pret pacientiem viņa attiecas rūpīgi, izpelnoties kolēģu atzinību. Tomēr Līla negaidīti sastingst kāda pacienta ultraskaņas izmeklēšanas laikā. Atklājas, ka Līlai ir disleksija, un viņai grūtības sagādā uzdevumi, kuriem nav laikus sagatavojusies. Devons jūt jaunajai sievietei līdzi, jo savulaik studiju laikā pats piedzīvojis šādus mācīšanās traucējumus.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Viena no labākajām mediķu drāmām pasaulē. Seriāls stāsta par Sietlas Greisas slimnīcu, tās ikdienu un darbinieku attiecībām. Stāsta centrā ir interne Meredita Greja, kuras māte bija lieliska ķirurģe, bet nu savu karjeru ir beigusi un sirgst ar Alcheimeru sākuma stadijā. Pirmā diena slimnīcā Mereditai sākas ar pārsteigumu – viņa tur satiek dakteri Dereku Šeperdu, kuru tikai šorīt ir izvadījusi no savām mājām pēc vienas nakts sakara. Neapdomīgā kārtā Meredita to atklāj citai internei, kas citiem nu liek domāt, ka Meredita savu karjeru kārtos caur gultu. Taču tā ir tikai pirmā diena.

programme.title: 19. ugunsdzēsēju depo
programme.desc: Komanda reaģē uz dzērumā izraisītu avāriju. Dīns saņēmis padomu no Pruita sarežģītā situācijā. Salivans meklē palīdzību.

programme.title: Rouzvuds
programme.desc: Rozvuds uzstāj, lai viņi ar Villu svinētu savu deviņu ar pusi mēnešu jubileju partneru statusā, kas viņus noved līdz lietai, kurā iesaistīts slepenais informants Džūliuss "Džu-Džu" Bīmans. Taču šoreiz Džu-Džu ir galvenais aizdomās turamais. Kamēr Rozvuds un Villa cenšas atklāt patiesību, pat ja tas nozīmētu Džu-Džu mūža ieslodzījumu, viņi atklāj pilnīgi jaunas un negaidītas senās paziņas personības šķautnes. Tikmēr Villas izvēle jaunajai mājai liek Rozvudam satraukties par viņas jauno ceļu, Pipijai un TMI ir grūti līdzsvarot vecos draugus un ģimeni, bet Hornstoks nevar saprast signālus no jaunās un spēcīgās policijas priekšnieces.

programme.title: Rouzvuds
programme.desc: Atrodoties ārpus pilsētas tiesu medicīnas konferencē, Rozvuds nejauši atklāj ideālas slepkavības pamatus, runājot ar konferences dalībniekiem. Neziņas vadīts un paļaujoties tikai uz intuīciju, Rozvuds iesaista Villu, lai kopīgi atrisinātu noziegumu, un slepenās izmeklēšanas laikā starp viņiem negaidīti uzliesmo jūtas. Papildus palīdzība tiek piesaistīta no Hornstoka un Floida Beitera. Tikmēr Pipija un TMI paliek laboratorijā pa nakti, lai palīdzētu izmeklēšanā, un TMI negaidīti apciemo sen nesatiktais tēvs.

programme.desc: Līdz ar Sofijas ierašanos mainās Ketrīnas prioritātes, bet Džonatana un Sašas konflikts sasniedz kulmināciju.

programme.title: Saules pretstati
programme.desc: Korvo mēģina iesaistīt ģimeni kosmosa kuģa remontā, taču tā vietā viņi apmeklē dzimšanas dienas svinības, kur Korvo iedvesmojas kļūt par burvi. Izmantojot savu datorsistēmu Aisha, Korvo izveido tehnoloģiski modernu burvju priekšnesumu; viņš kļūst par vīrusu un gatavojas Lasvegasas šovam, kura kulminācija būs viņa izlēciens caur melno caurumu.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Bila jaunākais atklājums ir apdraudēts pat tad, kad tuvojas nepatikšanas ar citplanētiešiem; Katrīnai jāizlemj, kam viņa ir lojāla.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Adīnas pasaules iznīcināšanas plāns tuvojas noslēgumam; alternatīvās pasaules iedzīvotājiem tiek uzbrukts.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Kad Adīnas plāns ir īstenots, pasaules pēdējā cerība ir, ka Bils dosies vēl vienā ceļojumā, riskējot ar savu dzīvību, meklējot Katrīnas palīdzību.

programme.title: Rezidents
programme.desc: Konrāds, Nika un Devons ārstē Trinitiju - apjukušu sievieti, kurai nepieciešams atsvabināties no mātes ietekmes. Viņai tiek diagnosticēta reta ģenētiska, bet ārstējama slimība. Belu sāk vajāt viņa profesionālās darbības cienītāja Fiona. Izrādās, ka šīs apsēstības iemesls ir audzējs. Minas vīzas termiņa pagarinājums ir atteikts, viņai draud deportācija, tāpēc viņa bildina Eidžī. Devons mēģina samierināties ar tēva nāvi, un viņa noskaņojumu tikai pasliktina mātes apciemojums.

programme.title: Rezidents
programme.desc: Ir Česteinas pēdējā darba diena pirms slēgšanas. Nika mēģina nomierināt uztrauktos cilvēku, un viņu sadur narkomāns. Situācija ir ļoti nopietna. Ultrasonogrāfijas attēli liecina, ka mazulis ir pārdzīvojis dūrienu, tomēr atklājas, ka Nikai ir vairogdziedzera problēmas, kas komplektā ar grūtniecību liedz atgūt viņai samaņu. Tikmēr pie samaņas nāk Keins, viņš nespēj pats elpot, tomēr nāk klajā ar risinājumu, kas izglābj kāda nedziedināmi slima pacienta dzīvību. Slimnīcu izdodas glābt, un tā kļūst par valsts finansētu iestādi.

programme.title: Rezidents
programme.desc: Divas nedēļas pēc saduršanas Nika joprojām ir slimnīcā un cieš no posttraumatiskā sindroma, un Konrāds negribīgi piezvana Nikas senai draudzenei Bilijai Satonei, kura no Česteinas tika atlaista, jo sakropļoja cilvēku. Par spīti savām nesaskaņām Bilija un Konrāds apvieno spēkus, lai palīdzētu Nikai. Tā kā Česteina tagad ir valsts slimnīca, to pārpludina pacienti, un vairāki ārsti pamet darbu. Bela audžudēls Džeiks pieņem piedāvājumu strādāt Česteinā, bet slimnīca meklē jaunu vadītāju.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Viena no labākajām mediķu drāmām pasaulē. Seriāls stāsta par Sietlas Greisas slimnīcu, tās ikdienu un darbinieku attiecībām. Stāsta centrā ir interne Meredita Greja, kuras māte bija lieliska ķirurģe, bet nu savu karjeru ir beigusi un sirgst ar Alcheimeru sākuma stadijā. Pirmā diena slimnīcā Mereditai sākas ar pārsteigumu – viņa tur satiek dakteri Dereku Šeperdu, kuru tikai šorīt ir izvadījusi no savām mājām pēc vienas nakts sakara. Neapdomīgā kārtā Meredita to atklāj citai internei, kas citiem nu liek domāt, ka Meredita savu karjeru kārtos caur gultu. Taču tā ir tikai pirmā diena.

programme.title: 19. ugunsdzēsēju depo
programme.desc: Bens un Džeks mēģina izglābt dzīvību, uzjundījot Džeka pagātnes atmiņas. Māja komandu aizved par tālu, nespējot visus vienot. Pruits draud pieņemt skarbus mērus.

programme.title: 19. ugunsdzēsēju depo
programme.desc: Mēģinot uzlabot noskaņojumu, Māja komandu aizved uz komandas veidošanas nometni, kas īsti līdz galam neizdodas. Viņu saikni pārbauda kāds lāča uzbrukums. Pruits mēģina atjaunot attiecības ar Endiju.

programme.title: Bīstamās mājsaimnieces
programme.desc: Bīstamās mājsaimnieces ir kulta seriāls, kurā galvenā darbība norisinās perfektos mājokļos tipiskā Amerikas priekšpilsētā. Šeit mīt šarmantas daiļā dzimuma pārstāves, kuru dzīves nebūt nav tik nevainojamas, kā varētu šķist no pirmā acu uzmetiena. Aiz katra namdurvīm rūpīgi tiek glabāti noslēpumi, slēptas pikantas privātās dzīves detaļas un vērptas intrigas... Mājsaimnieču lomās iejūtas Terija Hačere kā Sūzana Meijere, Nikoleta Šeridana kā Edija Brita, Eva Longorija kā Gabriela Solina, Mērsija Krosa kā Brī van de Kempa un Felicita Hafmane kā Lineta Skavo. Katra no šīm sievietēm ir īpašā veidā pievilcīga un sadzīvo ar savu noslēpumu. Sūzana ir vientuļā māte, kura dzīvo kopā ar pusaugu meitu un ir iemīlējusies kaimiņā amatniekā. Edija ir spēcīga konkurente Sūzanai cīņā par pievilcīgo amatnieku. Ediju nespēj atturēt nekas - viņas apģērbs ir tik trūcīgs, ka atsedz lielu daļu viņas skaistā ķermeņa. Gabriela ir precēta, bet par viņas iekāres tēlu kļūst dārznieks, kuram ir vien 17 gadu. Lineta ir četru bērneļu mamma, un viņai nenākas viegli tikt galā ar ikdienas mājas pienākumiem. Sievietes vīrs nespēj viņai palīdzēt, un par viņas glābiņu kļūst nomierinošās tabletes. Brī ir visu iepriekšminēto dāmu pretstats - viņa ģimenes dzīvi rūpīgi organizē, rūpējas par saimniecību, vīru un bērniem. Bet viņa ir tik ļoti pārņemta ar visa organizēšanu, ka iekārei uz seksu nav laika un vietas. Tas kļūst par iemeslu ģimenes konfliktam un ir pilnīgs pretstats kaimiņieņu seksa stāstiņiem. Seriāla laikā visu dāmu dzīves stāsti krustojas, veidojot interesantas un nereti intrigu caurvītas situācijas. Bīstamās mājsaimnieces dzīvo priekšpilsētā, un dzīve tur noris gluži kā Latvijas ciematos un mazpilsētās, kur galvenās aktualitātes ir pašu un kaimiņu dzīves. Seriāls Bīstamās mājsaimnieces pirmās sezonas laikā tika nominēts sešām Emmy, divām Zelta Globusa un divām Kino aktieru ģildes balvām. Felicita Hafmane, kas atveido Linetu, saņēma Emmy balvu kā labākā komēdiju seriālu aktrise. Terija Hačere, kas atveido Sūzanu, saņēma Zelta Globusa un Kino aktieru ģildes balvu. Turpmāko sezonu laikā seriāls Bīstamās mājsaimnieces ticis nominēts un ieguvis daudz un dažādas balvas - par labāko aktieru sastāvu, labāko muzikālo izpildījumu un otrā plāna aktieru piesaisti.

programme.title: Rezidents
programme.desc: Česteinā ierodas jauna ķirurģijas nodaļas interne Līla, gatava priekšzīmīgi veikt savus pienākumus. Pret pacientiem viņa attiecas rūpīgi, izpelnoties kolēģu atzinību. Tomēr Līla negaidīti sastingst kāda pacienta ultraskaņas izmeklēšanas laikā. Atklājas, ka Līlai ir disleksija, un viņai grūtības sagādā uzdevumi, kuriem nav laikus sagatavojusies. Devons jūt jaunajai sievietei līdzi, jo savulaik studiju laikā pats piedzīvojis šādus mācīšanās traucējumus.

programme.title: Rouzvuds
programme.desc: Rozvuds un Villa ienirst Maiami mākslas pasaulē, lai noķertu sērijveida slepkavu, kurš grasās radīt patiesu "šedevru". Kad medību grupai pievienojas TMI bijušais līgavainis, FBI detektīvs Hīts Kazablanka, viņš apdraud Pipijas un TMI attiecības. Hīts arī nonāk konfliktā ar Hornstoku, kurš varētu kļūt par policijas priekšnieku, ja noķers slepkavu. Tikmēr gaidāma tiesvedība pret Rozvudu apdraud Magic City Laboratorijas pastāvēšanu un liek Donnai nopietni pārdomāt, kā viņas dēls dzīvo savu dzīvi. Savukārt Rozvuds cenšas pasargāt Villu no sava labākā drauga Maika.

programme.title: Rouzvuds
programme.desc: Hornstoks piespiež Villu izvēlēties jaunu partneri, un viņa uzreiz sāk strīdēties ar norīkoto kolēģi. Uzzinot, ka viņa ir vainīga pie tā, ka Hornstoks nav kļuvis par policijas priekšnieku, Villa cenšas atvieglot viņa slogu, atklājot pārsteidzošu dzīves modeli. Tikmēr kāda upura nāve liek Pipijai piedalīties izmeklēšanā un pārskatīt savu pagātni. Šī lieta atklāj vecās brūces visai Rozvudu ģimenei un rada jaunas Pipijai un TMI. Savukārt Rozvuda izbīlis par veselību pamudina viņu meklēt jaunu kardiologu.

programme.title: Rouzvuds
programme.desc: Rozvuda sadarbība ar Villu nonāk krustcelēs, kad viņu piesaista darbam kopā ar nesen pārceltu detektīvu no Maiami austrumdaļas policijas, ar kuru Villai ir kopīga pagātne. Kamēr Villa un viņas jaunais partneris izmeklē priekšpilsētas zobārsta nāvi, kurš vadīja elitarās sabiedrības narkotiku ķēdi, Rozvuds nespēj atbrīvoties no sajūtas, ka viņa "aizstājējs" zina vairāk par upura narkotiku biznesu, nekā atklāj. Tikmēr izmeklēšanā tiek iesaistīta jauna pataloganatome Dr. Anita Jubanksa, un Hornstoka nedrošība neļauj viņam tikt galā ar sabiedriskajām attiecībām, liekot meklēt palīdzību negaidītā vietā.

programme.title: Mīlestībā un karā
programme.desc: Sieviešu-šķiršanās advokāšu komanda pamet vīriešu dominētu firmu, lai izveidotu savu spēkpilno praksi. Kvēlās, ģeniālās un emocionāli sarežģītās sievietes orientējas augsta riska šķiršanās lietās, skandalozos noslēpumos un mainīgās aliansēs kā tiesu zālē, tā savās rindās. Pasaulē, kur nauda runā un mīlestība ir kaujas lauks, šīs sievietes ne tikai spēlē spēli, bet arī to maina.

programme.title: Bīstamās mājsaimnieces
programme.desc: Pēc šausminošās aviokatastrofas, mājsaimnieces pārdomā dzīvi. Sūzena prāto, kā būtu izvērsusies viņas laulība ar Karlu, ja viņi nebūtu izšķīrušies. Brī iztēlojas, ka Orsons ir nomiris, un Karls aizved viņu tālu prom. Endžija domā, kas būtu noticis, ja Mona izdzīvotu un izstāstītu policijai visu, ko zina. Linete iztēlojas, ka Patriks ir izdzīvojis, bet uzzina, ka viņš ir miris, bet Peidža izdzīvojusi.

programme.title: Bīstamās mājsaimnieces
programme.desc: Bīstamās mājsaimnieces ir kulta seriāls, kurā galvenā darbība norisinās perfektos mājokļos tipiskā Amerikas priekšpilsētā. Šeit mīt šarmantas daiļā dzimuma pārstāves, kuru dzīves nebūt nav tik nevainojamas, kā varētu šķist no pirmā acu uzmetiena. Aiz katra namdurvīm rūpīgi tiek glabāti noslēpumi, slēptas pikantas privātās dzīves detaļas un vērptas intrigas... Mājsaimnieču lomās iejūtas Terija Hačere kā Sūzana Meijere, Nikoleta Šeridana kā Edija Brita, Eva Longorija kā Gabriela Solina, Mērsija Krosa kā Brī van de Kempa un Felicita Hafmane kā Lineta Skavo. Katra no šīm sievietēm ir īpašā veidā pievilcīga un sadzīvo ar savu noslēpumu. Sūzana ir vientuļā māte, kura dzīvo kopā ar pusaugu meitu un ir iemīlējusies kaimiņā amatniekā. Edija ir spēcīga konkurente Sūzanai cīņā par pievilcīgo amatnieku. Ediju nespēj atturēt nekas - viņas apģērbs ir tik trūcīgs, ka atsedz lielu daļu viņas skaistā ķermeņa. Gabriela ir precēta, bet par viņas iekāres tēlu kļūst dārznieks, kuram ir vien 17 gadu. Lineta ir četru bērneļu mamma, un viņai nenākas viegli tikt galā ar ikdienas mājas pienākumiem. Sievietes vīrs nespēj viņai palīdzēt, un par viņas glābiņu kļūst nomierinošās tabletes. Brī ir visu iepriekšminēto dāmu pretstats - viņa ģimenes dzīvi rūpīgi organizē, rūpējas par saimniecību, vīru un bērniem. Bet viņa ir tik ļoti pārņemta ar visa organizēšanu, ka iekārei uz seksu nav laika un vietas. Tas kļūst par iemeslu ģimenes konfliktam un ir pilnīgs pretstats kaimiņieņu seksa stāstiņiem. Seriāla laikā visu dāmu dzīves stāsti krustojas, veidojot interesantas un nereti intrigu caurvītas situācijas. Bīstamās mājsaimnieces dzīvo priekšpilsētā, un dzīve tur noris gluži kā Latvijas ciematos un mazpilsētās, kur galvenās aktualitātes ir pašu un kaimiņu dzīves. Seriāls Bīstamās mājsaimnieces pirmās sezonas laikā tika nominēts sešām Emmy, divām Zelta Globusa un divām Kino aktieru ģildes balvām. Felicita Hafmane, kas atveido Linetu, saņēma Emmy balvu kā labākā komēdiju seriālu aktrise. Terija Hačere, kas atveido Sūzanu, saņēma Zelta Globusa un Kino aktieru ģildes balvu. Turpmāko sezonu laikā seriāls Bīstamās mājsaimnieces ticis nominēts un ieguvis daudz un dažādas balvas - par labāko aktieru sastāvu, labāko muzikālo izpildījumu un otrā plāna aktieru piesaisti.

programme.title: Ēnu čuksti
programme.desc: Melinda uzzina, ka viņai jāaptur spoks, kas nevēlas reinkarnēties. Tāpat viņa uzzina, ka kāds zina viņas noslēpumus.

programme.title: Rouzvuds
programme.desc: Rozvuds un Villa ienirst Maiami mākslas pasaulē, lai noķertu sērijveida slepkavu, kurš grasās radīt patiesu "šedevru". Kad medību grupai pievienojas TMI bijušais līgavainis, FBI detektīvs Hīts Kazablanka, viņš apdraud Pipijas un TMI attiecības. Hīts arī nonāk konfliktā ar Hornstoku, kurš varētu kļūt par policijas priekšnieku, ja noķers slepkavu. Tikmēr gaidāma tiesvedība pret Rozvudu apdraud Magic City Laboratorijas pastāvēšanu un liek Donnai nopietni pārdomāt, kā viņas dēls dzīvo savu dzīvi. Savukārt Rozvuds cenšas pasargāt Villu no sava labākā drauga Maika.

programme.title: Rouzvuds
programme.desc: Hornstoks piespiež Villu izvēlēties jaunu partneri, un viņa uzreiz sāk strīdēties ar norīkoto kolēģi. Uzzinot, ka viņa ir vainīga pie tā, ka Hornstoks nav kļuvis par policijas priekšnieku, Villa cenšas atvieglot viņa slogu, atklājot pārsteidzošu dzīves modeli. Tikmēr kāda upura nāve liek Pipijai piedalīties izmeklēšanā un pārskatīt savu pagātni. Šī lieta atklāj vecās brūces visai Rozvudu ģimenei un rada jaunas Pipijai un TMI. Savukārt Rozvuda izbīlis par veselību pamudina viņu meklēt jaunu kardiologu.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Viena no labākajām mediķu drāmām pasaulē. Seriāls stāsta par Sietlas Greisas slimnīcu, tās ikdienu un darbinieku attiecībām. Stāsta centrā ir interne Meredita Greja, kuras māte bija lieliska ķirurģe, bet nu savu karjeru ir beigusi un sirgst ar Alcheimeru sākuma stadijā. Pirmā diena slimnīcā Mereditai sākas ar pārsteigumu – viņa tur satiek dakteri Dereku Šeperdu, kuru tikai šorīt ir izvadījusi no savām mājām pēc vienas nakts sakara. Neapdomīgā kārtā Meredita to atklāj citai internei, kas citiem nu liek domāt, ka Meredita savu karjeru kārtos caur gultu. Taču tā ir tikai pirmā diena.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Vērienīgajā sezonas noslēgumā izdzīvojušie mēģina reizi par visām reizēm vērst cīņas gaitu sev par labu un dot triecienu saviem uzbrucējiem. Mokrani un Ketrīna gatavojas savas dzīves izšķirošajai cīņai. Emīlija ir apņēmības pilna rast atbildes uz saviem jautājumiem par katru cenu, bet Sašu turpina vajāt vīzijas.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Ketrīnu satricina jauni atklājumi, bet Londonā izdzīvojušie uzsāk cīņu pret iebrucējiem. Emīlijas atgriešanās vieš cerību, taču pēc ilgās prombūtnes ne visi ir pārliecināti, ka viņa joprojām ir viņu pusē…

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: LokSat is the dirty drug-running and money laundering operation with tentacles that spread to the highest levels of the CIA, and even as far as Senator William Bracken—the currently jailed politician responsible for Beckett's mother's murder. Castle and Beckett have a lead that they believe will allow them to bring down LokSat once and for all. They are trailing a lawyer named Caleb Brown, who they believe is carrying a memory stick packed with incriminating information, and is about to make contact with a high-ranking LokSat operative. They lie in wait near the rendezvous as "Caleb" comes into view. Then a call comes through from Lanie. She has identified the burned remains of a body found in the locked boot of a torched car— it is Caleb. Castle and Beckett have been trapped. LokSat seem to be holding all the aces. But is there a joker in the pack who can out-trump them?

programme.title: Criminal Minds
programme.desc: An elite team of FBI profilers analyze the country's most twisted criminal minds, anticipating their next moves before they strike again. As the team evolves together, the Behavioral Analysis Unit continues its dedication to using their expertise to pinpoint predators' motivations and identify their emotional triggers in the attempt to stop them. Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

programme.title: Will Trent
programme.desc: Based on Karin Slaughter's New York Times best-selling "Will Trent" series, Special Agent Will Trent of the Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI) was abandoned at birth and endured a harsh coming-of-age in Atlanta's overwhelmed foster care system. programme.title: Bones
programme.desc: When a powerful member of the Iranian parliament kidnaps Arastoo (guest star Pej Vahdat) to have him aid in a murder case, Booth and Cam head to Iran, and the rest of the Jeffersonian team must race against the clock to help expose the killer. Meanwhile, Brennan discovers the truth about Booth's growing gambling habit, and she turns to Aubrey for help to keep her and Christine safe from her husband's menacing bookie.

Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk and Tim Minear reimagine the procedural drama with "9-1-1." The series explores the high-pressure experiences of first responders -- including police officers, firefighters and dispatchers -- who are thrust into the most frightening, shocking and heart-stopping situations. These emergency responders must try to balance saving those who are at their most vulnerable with solving the problems in their own lives. The show draws from real-life, high-pressure experiences of first responders who regularly face heart-stopping situations that are often unpredictable, intense and uplifting at the same time.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: When astronomers detect a transmission from another galaxy, it is definitive proof of intelligent extra-terrestrial life. The world's population waits for further contact with bated breath. They do not have to wait long. Within days, mankind is all but wiped out by a devastating attack; pockets of humanity are left in an eerily deserted world. As aliens hunt and kill those left alive, the survivors ask a burning question – who are these attackers and why are they hell-bent on our destruction? Emotional, cinematic and rooted in character, it is a unique marriage of human drama and the best science fiction. This is a story of ordinary people in extraordinary circumstances - but they are more than just victims in a brutal war. For, as we will come to realize, the aliens' savage attack on earth is not arbitrary: its seeds are being sown before our very eyes.

programme.title: Solar Opposites
programme.desc: How would Earth look to alien settlers? Awesome or awful? Well that's the contrasting opinions of an alien family in this animated American sitcom. A year ago, the alien family fled the destruction of their planet Shlorp and crashed on Earth, beginning a new life in foreign surroundings, where they must adjust to the idiosyncrasies of the human world. The family is made up of partners Korvo and Terry, and their child-replicants Yumyulack and Jesse. The show was created by Justin Roiland (Rick and Morty) and Mike McMahan, with voices provided by Roiland, Thomas Middleditch, Sean Giambrone, and Mary Mack, among others.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K.
programme.desc: Genius super villain M.O.D.O.K. spends his time juggling his evil scientific empire, AIM, and his responsibilities as a husband and father to two teens. Due to financial strains, M.O.D.O.K. is sweet-talked into selling AIM to tech giant GRUMBL. Upon realizing his mistake, M.O.D.O.K. goes to super villainous lengths to get his company back, even going as far as mind-controlling his own wife. He ultimately fails to save AIM, and his lifelong obsession with conquering the world leaves his wife, Jodie, with only one option ― divorce.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K.
programme.desc: In a bid to save his marriage, M.O.D.O.K. takes Jodie back in time to a concert they missed when they were in college. During a detour to kill the child-version of his GRUMBL boss, M.O.D.O.K. and Jodie are attacked by college-aged M.O.D.O.K., who accidentally absorbs their time crystals, stranding them in 2002. The couple reconciles but is stuck in the past until they catch up to the present. Once in the present, they prevent themselves from ever going to the past in the first place, erasing their entire adventure from the timeline.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Deciding to crack open a bottle of scotch and hunker down for the night, Castle's assistant and daughter are disturbed by a noise outside, alarmed by an axe splintering the door, and finally terrified when a crazed man walks in. Before Alexis can retrieve her father's gun, the man drops to the floor, dead. The next day, Lanie's autopsy reveals that the man was covered in religious scriptures, drawn in ink all over his body. He died of stab wounds, the attacker having left a clawlike gash with traces of sulphur. Castle is convinced the killer must be a demon. The case becomes more demonic still when Castle realises the dead man was trying to reach a safe in his office, that has remained unopened since Castle took on the building. After it is cracked open, an artefact known as the Angel Blade is discovered, a weapon that can kill the son of the devil. But who was the intended target?

programme.title: Bones
programme.desc: Dr. Temperance Brennan is a highly skilled forensic anthropologist who works at the Jeffersonian Institute and writes novels as a sideline. When the standard methods of identifying a body are deemed useless--when the remains are so badly decomposed, burned or destroyed that CSI gives up-- law enforcement calls in Brennan for her uncanny ability to read clues left behind in the victim's bones. Most law enforcement is unable to handle Brennan's intelligence, her drive for the truth, or the way she flings herself headlong into every investigation. FBI Special Agent Seeley Booth is the exception. A former Army sniper, Booth mistrusts science and scientists--the "squints," as he calls them, who pore over the physical evidence-- when it comes to solving crimes. But even he cannot deny that the combination of his people-smarts and Brennan's scientific acumen make them a formidable team.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Rick Castle is one of the world's most successful crime authors. But when his rock star lifestyle isn't enough, this bad boy goes looking for new trouble and finds it working with smart, beautiful Detective Kate Beckett. Inspired by her professional record and intrigued by her buttoned-up personality, Castle's found the model for his bold new character whether she likes it or not. Now with the mayor's permission, Castle is helping solve crime with his own twist.

As the team evolves together, the Behavioral Analysis Unit continues its dedication to using their expertise to pinpoint predators' motivations and identify their emotional triggers in the attempt to stop them. Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

programme.title: Will Trent
programme.desc: Based on Karin Slaughter's New York Times best-selling "Will Trent" series, Special Agent Will Trent of the Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI) was abandoned at birth and endured a harsh coming-of-age in Atlanta's overwhelmed foster care system. But now, determined to use his unique point of view to make sure no one is abandoned like he was, Will Trent has the highest clearance rate in the GBI. Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: LokSat is the dirty drug-running and money laundering operation with tentacles that spread to the highest levels of the CIA, and even as far as Senator William Bracken—the currently jailed politician responsible for Beckett's mother's murder. Castle and Beckett have a lead that they believe will allow them to bring down LokSat once and for all. They are trailing a lawyer named Caleb Brown, who they believe is carrying a memory stick packed with incriminating information, and is about to make contact with a high-ranking LokSat operative. They lie in wait near the rendezvous as "Caleb" comes into view. Then a call comes through from Lanie. She has identified the burned remains of a body found in the locked boot of a torched car— it is Caleb. Castle and Beckett have been trapped. LokSat seem to be holding all the aces. But is there a joker in the pack who can out-trump them?

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: When two separate murders are committed on the same night, Castle wagers Ryan and Esposito that he and Beckett will solve theirs first. The frenzied race to catch their respective killers and win the bet leads each investigative duo to a likely suspect, only to find that they both have air-tight alibis. But bizarre twists in both cases force the two teams to work together to unravel the mind-bending mystery behind each murder.

programme.title: Bones
programme.desc: Dr. Temperance Brennan is a highly skilled forensic anthropologist who works at the Jeffersonian Institute and writes novels as a sideline. When the standard methods of identifying a body are deemed useless--when the remains are so badly decomposed, burned or destroyed that CSI gives up-- law enforcement calls in Brennan for her uncanny ability to read clues left behind in the victim's bones. Most law enforcement is unable to handle Brennan's intelligence, her drive for the truth, or the way she flings herself headlong into every investigation. FBI Special Agent Seeley Booth is the exception. A former Army sniper, Booth mistrusts science and scientists--the "squints," as he calls them, who pore over the physical evidence-- when it comes to solving crimes. But even he cannot deny that the combination of his people-smarts and Brennan's scientific acumen make them a formidable team.

Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk and Tim Minear reimagine the procedural drama with "9-1-1." The series explores the high-pressure experiences of first responders -- including police officers, firefighters and dispatchers -- who are thrust into the most frightening, shocking and heart-stopping situations. These emergency responders must try to balance saving those who are at their most vulnerable with solving the problems in their own lives. The show draws from real-life, high-pressure experiences of first responders who regularly face heart-stopping situations that are often unpredictable, intense and uplifting at the same time.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: When astronomers detect a transmission from another galaxy, it is definitive proof of intelligent extra-terrestrial life. The world's population waits for further contact with bated breath. They do not have to wait long. Within days, mankind is all but wiped out by a devastating attack; pockets of humanity are left in an eerily deserted world. As aliens hunt and kill those left alive, the survivors ask a burning question – who are these attackers and why are they hell-bent on our destruction? Emotional, cinematic and rooted in character, it is a unique marriage of human drama and the best science fiction. This is a story of ordinary people in extraordinary circumstances - but they are more than just victims in a brutal war. For, as we will come to realize, the aliens' savage attack on earth is not arbitrary: its seeds are being sown before our very eyes.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K.
programme.desc: Genius super villain M.O.D.O.K. spends his time juggling his evil scientific empire, AIM, and his responsibilities as a husband and father to two teens. Due to financial strains, M.O.D.O.K. is sweet-talked into selling AIM to tech giant GRUMBL. Upon realizing his mistake, M.O.D.O.K. goes to super villainous lengths to get his company back, even going as far as mind-controlling his own wife. He ultimately fails to save AIM, and his lifelong obsession with conquering the world leaves his wife, Jodie, with only one option ― divorce.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K.
programme.desc: In a bid to save his marriage, M.O.D.O.K. takes Jodie back in time to a concert they missed when they were in college. During a detour to kill the child-version of his GRUMBL boss, M.O.D.O.K. and Jodie are attacked by college-aged M.O.D.O.K., who accidentally absorbs their time crystals, stranding them in 2002. The couple reconciles but is stuck in the past until they catch up to the present. Once in the present, they prevent themselves from ever going to the past in the first place, erasing their entire adventure from the timeline.

programme.title: Solar Opposites
programme.desc: Korvo tries to get the family involved in repairing the spaceship, but they attend a birthday party instead, where he is inspired to become a magician. Using his computer system Aisha, Korvo creates a technologically advanced magic act; he goes viral and prepares for a Las Vegas show, which will culminate in him leaping through a black hole. Korvo ignores his family's warning that jealous magicians plan to kill him; the family save him from being shot, but he dies when the black hole trick goes awry. The grieving family agree to repair the ship in Korvo's memory, and he reappears, having faked his death to bring them closer together. Yumyulack adds a woman named Cherie to his shrunken collection.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K.
programme.desc: M.O.D.O.K brings Melissa and Lou along to a remote GRUMBL leadership conference. After learning that he's not the guest of honor, M.O.D.O.K. enlists Melissa's help in manipulating the executives into respecting him. His schemes accidentally lead to him opening up a portal that brings the dangerously hedonistic alien species, the Ciegrimites, to the conference. While the aliens are initially the life of the party, executives begin to drop dead from partying too hard, leading M.O.D.O.K. and Melissa to wipe out the Ciegrimites and save the conference.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K.
programme.desc: After getting kicked out of the A-List villains' Soho Lair, M.O.D.O.K. decides to slum it at The Bar With No Name. There, he forms a crew of street-level baddies, intent on using them for a heist that will get him back into the Soho Lair. However, after a wild night of bonding and backstory sharing, they form a real camaraderie. Meanwhile, Jodie goes looking for M.O.D.O.K. at AIM and bonds with Monica while Lou meets Monica's daughter, Carmilla. College-aged M.O.D.O.K. has returned from the time stream and kidnaps the Super Adaptoid.

programme.title: Criminal Minds
programme.desc: While fixing a burst water main, a city works crew digs up the back yard of the home of the Johnsons - father Charles, mother Tina, and their middle aged son Lyle - upon Tina's approval. The Johnsons have lived at the house for thirty-five years. The crew finds the skeletons of two human bodies buried in the yard. The BAU takes the three members of the Johnson family in for questioning, who they believe know something about the skeletons, primarily because Lyle ran when he saw the authorities at the house. While Hotch, JJ, Morgan, Rossi and Cruz question the Johnsons individually, Lyle initially comes across as the most guilty by his animosity, however the team eventually believes his attitude is more a facade hiding other issues. Charles also demonstrates a more reserved form of animosity, he being a history buff who continually implies how he and his family, as being black, have been persecuted, this situation being no different. The identification of the two bodies and of the others which are eventually found in the yard, in addition to what Reid and Blake are able to find in the Johnson house may piece the puzzle together. Meanwhile, JJ wants to divulge to the team the fact that she and Cruz have been on special assignment, against Cruz's wants.

programme.title: Criminal Minds
programme.desc: The BAU heads to St. Louis, Missouri where ten year old Andrew Taffert has gone missing. The reason it is a BAU case is that the Tafferts - father Malcolm Taffert and mother Lida Taffert - had been receiving prank calls from someone with a childlike voice stating "I'm gonna get you", and that blood was splattered on their front door after Andy had gone missing. Reid notices that this case is much like a fifteen year old cold case that the BAU worked on where the parents in that situation received such prank calls prior to their son being abducted and eventually found dead. The father in that case, Richard Clayvin, was always considered a suspect. As such, Malcolm is initially considered a prime suspect, especially considering his over controlling temperament. The similarity between the two cases extends to the post-abduction prank calls with the voice changing its statement to, "Did you see what I did?". But as the investigation progresses, which includes re-interviewing Richard Clayvin, the team may have to find other similarities before they can identify the unsub.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Rick Castle is one of the world's most successful crime authors. But when his rock star lifestyle isn't enough, this bad boy goes looking for new trouble and finds it working with smart, beautiful Detective Kate Beckett. Inspired by her professional record and intrigued by her buttoned-up personality, Castle's found the model for his bold new character whether she likes it or not. Now with the mayor's permission, Castle is helping solve crime with his own twist.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Late one night, two security officers unload an armoured van. As one delivers some of its contents to a secure office, the other is shot dead by an attacker who rappels down from the ceiling. At the scene, the team discover a peculiar blue gel that may have been used to disable security devices. This, Espinosa recalls, was the same method used in another case years earlier, by a gang led by a woman named Sonia Ruiz. Beckett visits Ruiz in jail, and she offers to help with the case, if Beckett can get her out. Beckett manages to make this happen, but is then shocked to discover that Ruiz is Espinosa's former fiancée. Espinosa trusts Ruiz, but the team are led on a merry dance after she slips from their chains.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Hayley is instructed to team up with a guy named Marcus, who will get her access to the office of a leading energy firm. There she is to install some spyware onto the boss's computer, in an effort to prove what his wife believes—that he is being unfaithful. Having broken into the office, Hayley and Marcus take cover after the boss arrives with an attractive young woman. Hayley sneaks out without being seen, but Marcus stays, and the team are called in when his dead body is discovered the next morning. The man who hired her tells Hayley to get out of town immediately, but her escape plan is interrupted by Castle's daughter Alexis. It transpires that, rather than spyware, Hayley has unwittingly uploaded coding that leads to a power blackout, switching the lights out all over London. Soon the FBI have a warrant out for Hayley's arrest, believing she is a terrorist. And the London blackout puts MI-6 on her trail too. Can Castle and Alexis prove her innocence? Or does Hayley have a hidden dark side that is only now coming to light?

programme.title: Putekļu kamoliņš
programme.desc: Auroras noslēpumainais kaimiņš ir algots slepkava, kas medī īstus monstrus. Viņš apsola palīdzēt meitenītei atriebties briesmonim, kas, pēc meitenes domām, aprijis viņas ģimeni. Taču, aizstāvot Auroru pret briesmoņiem, viņš drīz saprot, ka daži monstri patiešām eksistē.

programme.title: Pasaules gala mednieki
programme.desc: Pēc tam kad milzīga saules uzliesmojuma dēļ tiek iznīcināta Zemes austrumu puslode, drosmīgs algots dārgumu mednieks dodas uz Eiropu, lai atrastu iekāroto "Monu Lizu", taču drīz saprot, ka pasaulei šobrīd vajag varoni vairāk nekā gleznu.

programme.title: Grāfs Monte-Kristo
programme.desc: Izbēdzis no cietuma uz salas, kurā, nepatiesi apsūdzēts par valsts nodevību, pavadījis četrpadsmit gadus, Edmunds Dantess atgriežas kā grāfs Monte-Kristo, lai atriebtos vīriem, kas viņu nodevuši.

programme.title: Nav izejas
programme.desc: Jaunā studente Dārbija Torna mēģina sakārtot savu dzīvi rehabilitācijas klīnikā, līdz uzzina, ka viņas māte atrodas slimnīcā kritiskā stāvoklī. Nerēķinoties ar briesmām un tuvojošos sniega vētru, Dārbija bēg no klīnikas, lai dotos pie mātes. Daba izrādās stiprāka, un meitene ir spiesta nakts vidū meklēt patvērumu nomaļā lielceļa pieturvietā, kur sastop četrus svešiniekus: Sendiju, Edu, Ešu un Larsu. Gaisotne ir saspīlēta, tomēr Dārbijai šķiet, ka ļaunākais šajā naktī ir neparedzētā aizkavēšanās. Taču, mēģinot stāvvietā "noķert" mobilo sakaru zonu, Dārbija kādas automašīnas bagāžniekā nejauši pamana nolaupītu meiteni. Palīdzību izsaukt nav iespējams, ceļi ir aizputināti, un viņa saprot - viens no četriem cilvēkiem, ar kuriem viņa tikko malkoja kafiju un spēlēja kārtis, ir bīstams noziedznieks. Dārbija apņemas glābt mazo meiteni, neapjaušot, ka šī nakts pārvērtīsies īstā murgā.

programme.title: Mis Moksi
programme.desc: Mis Moksi, pieradināta kaķenīte, brīvdienu laikā apmaldās, un viņai nākas atrast ceļu atpakaļ uz mājām, ceļojot cauri Dienvideiropai kopā ar, kaķa skatījumā, visnepatīkamākajām radībām, kādas vien iespējamas, – komisku suni un vecu, gudru putnu. Šī ceļojuma laikā viņa paplašina savu skatījumu uz dzīvi un atklāj patieso draudzības nozīmi.

programme.title: Ferdinands
programme.desc: Ferdinands ir pats labsirdīgākais bullis visā Spānijā. Neskatoties uz iespaidīgajiem izmēriem un milzu spēku, viņš jau kopš bērnības neizrādīja sevišķu interesi par badīšanos ar saviem sugas brāļiem. Nejaušības dēļ Ferdinands nokļūst to vidū, kuri tiek izvēlēti, lai piedalītos buļļu cīņās Madridē. Tagad Ferdinandam nāksies aizstāvēt savus miermīlīgos dzīves uzskatus un atgādināt pārējiem, ka grūtību priekšā galvenais ir palikt, kāds tu esi. Jo tikai tā tu spēsi izmainīt pasauli sev apkārt.

programme.title: Gabijas leļļu māja: Filma
programme.desc: Gabija kopā ar savu vecmāmiņu Džidži dodas ceļā uz pilsētu brīnumzemi Kaķfrancisko. Kad Gabijas leļļu namiņš nonāk ekscentriskas kaķu dāmas Veras rokās, sākas piedzīvojums, lai atkal sapulcinātu Gabijas kaķus un glābtu leļļu namiņu, pirms nav par vēlu.

programme.title: Zirnekļcilvēks: Pāri Zirnekļpasaulei
programme.desc: Mailss Moraless atgriežas uz ekrāniem nākamajā ar Oskaru apbalvotās Zirnekļpasaules sāgas nodaļā. Varenais piedzīvojums nogādās Zirnekļcilvēku no Bruklinas draudzīgās apkaimes pāri Zirnekļpasaulei, lai viņš apvienotu spēkus ar Gvenu Steisiju un jauno zirnekļļaužu komandu un stātos pretī ļaundarim, par kuru spēcīgāku viņi vēl nav satikuši.

programme.title: Smurfi
programme.desc: Laipni lūdzam smurfu pasaulē! Burvis Gargamels ir piespiedis smurfus bēgt no dzimtā ciema. Ģimenes komēdija, kurā animācijas filmas varoņi parādās spēlfilmā.

programme.title: Dusmīgie putni. Filma
programme.desc: Reiz uz kādas paradīzes salas dzīvoja putni, kas nemācēja lidot. Tāpēc viņi visi bija labi, miermīlīgi un laimīgi... Precīzāk, gandrīz visi. Uz pārējo salas iemītnieku fona depresīvais Reds, trauksmainais Čaks un neveiklais Bumba izcēlās ar savu neparedzamo uzvedību un skaitījās izstumtie. Taču, kad salā pēkšņi parādījās noslēpumainās zaļās cūkas, kam noteikti aiz ādas bija kāda cūcība, tieši Reds, Čaks un Bumba stājās viņiem pretī!

programme.title: Džonijs Pafs: Slepenā misija
programme.desc: Džonijs ar draugiem uzsāk slepenu misiju, lai glābtu ciemu no valzirga Oto ļaunajiem plāniem.

programme.title: Debesis patiešām ir īstas
programme.desc: Kādam mazpilsētas tēvam jāatrod drosme un pārliecība pastāstīt pasaulei par sava mazā dēla īpašo, dzīvi mainošo pieredzējumu.

programme.title: Tuksneša bērns
programme.desc: 14 gadus vecā Suna sarakstījusi un veiksmīgi publicējusi stāstu, ko viņai mēdza stāstīt vectēvs – neticamo stāstu par Hadaru, bērnu savvaļā, kuru izglāba strausu bars un uzaudzināja tuksnesī starp savvaļas dzīvniekiem, ieskaitot viņa labāko draugu, burvīgo tuksneša lapsu.

programme.title: Ēnu spēle
programme.desc: Treviss Bloks ir FIB problēmu risinātājs. Kad slepenie aģenti nonāk nepatikšanās, Treviss tiek izsaukts, lai viņus izpestītu. Par katru cenu. Taču, kad viens no slepenajiem aģentiem apšauba savas priekšniecības patiesos mērķus, Treviss nonāk asiņainas sazvērestības epicentrā.

programme.title: Brutālists
programme.desc: Bēgdams no pēckara Eiropas, arhitekts Lāslo Tots ierodas Amerikā, lai sāktu jaunu dzīvi, atrastu darbu un gaidītu sievu Eržēbeti, kura cenšas izkļūt no Austrumeiropas. Svešajā un jaunajā valstī Lāslo apmetas Filadelfijā, kur bagātais un ietekmīgais rūpnieks Harisons Lī Van Būrens pamana viņa talantu. Lāslo ir jāatrod savs ceļš jaunajā pasaulē, kurā valda citi noteikumi. Amerikāņu sapnis šķiet iluzors, panākumi un slava maksā lielu cenu…

programme.title: Nāve bērēs
programme.desc: Kad kuplas britu ģimenes tēvs mirst, tiek sarīkotas grandiozas bēres. Tomēr tajās haosu izraisa kāds vīrs, kam esot zināmi tumši noslēpumi par aizgājēju. Šantāžists ir gatavs saglabāt ģimenes reputāciju, viņa vārdiem sakot, par mazu summu, bet ar daudzām nullēm.

programme.title: Mīluļi apvienojas
programme.desc: Klusā, bet ļoti mūsdienīgā pilsētā Robo notiek kas neredzēts un nedzirdēts. Mērs Frenks ir zaudējis prātu. Viņa plāns neiekļaujas nekādos rāmjos. Tikai paklausieties! Viņam apnikuši cilvēki un dzīvnieki, tāpēc viņš savā prātā perina plānu - visus iedzīvotājus un mājdzīvniekus izdzīt no pilsētas un viņu mājas atdot robotiem! Kad suns bez pajumtes Rodžers uzzina šo jaunumu, viņam visas spalvas saceļas stāvus. Šis Robins Huds daudz laika pavadījis uz ielas, nočiepis dažu labu gardas desas luņķi, lai to atdotu vājākiem dzīvniekiem, un nu jūt, ka mēra plāns pie laba gala nenovedīs. No pilsētas pazudīs dzīvība! Atgriezies no jaukas pastaigas kopā ar daiļo Siāmas kaķenīti Bellu, Rodžers šausmās sastingst. Roboti sagrāvuši viņa vienīgo būdiņu! Mukdams ko nagi nes, Rodžers piepeši satiek labsirdīgo robotu Bobu, kuram mēra nodoms šķiet briesmīgs. Ir jārīkojas! Jāglābjas pašiem un jāglābj citi. Ja nekas netiks darīts, greznā mājdzīvnieku viesnīca būs briesmās. Nekā ļauna nenojauzdami, tajā mitinās daudzi četrkājainie.

programme.title: Bitīte Maija: Medus spēles
programme.desc: Strops satraukti dūc – nupat novākta vasaras medus raža. Varbūt beidzot spiets tiks izraudzīts dalībai Medus spēlēs? Maijas jaukais satraukums zūd, kad viņa uzzina, ka strops nepiedalīsies spēlēs, turklāt puse ražas būs jāatdod spēļu dalībniekiem. Maijai tas šķiet netaisnīgi. Bez stropa karalienes atļaujas viņa grasās lidot uz Zumtropoli pie imperatores un lūgt atļauju piedalīties spēlēs, pārstāvot savu stropu. Cenzdamās pierādīt stropa karalienei, ko bites spēj, Maija apsola gūt uzvaru Medus spēlēs un glābt stropa medu. Karaliene piekrīt, bet atgādina, ka, vedot komandu cīņā, Maijai vispirms jāiemācās uzklausīt citus. Maija piedalās spēlēs kopā ar labāko draugu Villiju un seno biedru vaboļu komandu. Drīz viņa sastop skaudīgo bitīti Vijolīti no Zumtropoles, kura ar viltu cenšas atņemt Maijas komandai uzvaru. Bitītei nākas piedzīvot viltus rūgtumu, taču negodīgā Vijolīte un viņas komanda arī iekuļas ķibelē.

programme.title: Lemāna-'66: Lielais izaicinājums
programme.desc: Filmas sižets balstīts patiesos notikumus un atgādina par autosporta vēstures spriedzes pilnām lapaspusēm. Notikumi risinās 60. gados, kad konstruktoru grupa, kuru vadīja Kerols Šelbijs, kopā ar britu sacīkšu braucēju Kenu Mailsu uzbūvēja vēl nebijušu "Ford" sporta automašīnu un meta izaicinājumu Lemānas 24 stundu sacīkšu favorītam "Ferrari".

programme.title: Flīks
programme.desc: Zaudējis spēju staigāt, Tomass apvienojas ar maģisku radījumu, lai stātos pretī ēnu briesmonim un atveseļotos.

programme.title: Viens pats mājās
programme.desc: Baksteru ģimene pārceļas uz dzīvi citā štatā, taču 10 gadus veco Finnu biedē jaunā māja, jo viņš uzskata, ka tajā spokojas. Kamēr puisēns izliek slazdus, lai notvertu "spoku", viņa vecāki aizkavējas citā pilsētas malā un viņš paliek mājās kopā ar māsu. Tikmēr trīs zagļi vēlas iegūt ārkārtīgi dārgu gleznu, kuru bijušais īpašnieks paslēpis slepenā telpā. Vai viņiem izdosies iegūt kāroto un uzvarēt kaujā ar mazo gudrinieku?

programme.title: Dauntonas abatija: Lielais noslēgums
programme.desc: Krouliju ģimene un Dauntonas abatijas personāls bauda spožo Londonas sezonu 1930. gada vasarā. Lēdijas Pītersfīldas ballē – augstākās sabiedrības spilgtākajā notikumā – kāds šokējošs paziņojums ievelk lēdiju Mēriju skandāla virpulī. Drīz viņas ģimene saskaras ar finansiālām grūtībām, un Dauntonas abatijai draud grūti laiki. Ģimenei ir jāpieņem tuvojošās pārmaiņas, kurās ģimenes jaunā paaudze pavērs Dauntonas abatijai durvis uz jaunu nākotni.

programme.title: Mēs nopirkām zvērudārzu
programme.desc: Patiess stāsts par Bendžaminu Mī un viņa ģimeni, kuri izmantoja visus savus ietaupījumus, lai nopirktu izputinātu zvērudārzu. Ar raibas komandas palīdzību un cīnoties ar dažādām nebūšanām, ģimene dara visu, lai atjaunotu zvērudārzu un atkal atvērtu to apmeklētājiem.

programme.title: Ingrīda - pašiņu karaliene
programme.desc: Ingrīda (Obrija Plaza) ir īstena sociālo tīklu stalkere, kuras dzīvē viens nejauši nospiests LIKE jau ir pielīdzināms īstai draudzībai, pat ja otra puse par to nemaz nenojauš. Teilore Slouna (Elizabete Olsena) ir atzīta Losandželosas sociālo tīklu karaliene un Instagrama zvaigzne, kuras līdz pēdējam pikselim noslīpētā, perfektā dzīve kļūst par Ingrīdas jaunāko apsēstību. Kad Ingrīda ar viltu ienāk Teilores dzīvē, viņu attiecības no #BFF ātri vien kļūst par #WTF. Un tas ir tikai sākums...

programme.title: Mirušie nesāpina
programme.desc: Divi pionieri Amerikas pilsoņu kara laikā frontē cīnās par savu dzīvību un mīlestību.

programme.title: Valis
programme.desc: Angļu valodas skolotājs Čārlijs (Brendans Freizers) reiz pameta ģimeni, lai būtu kopā ar mīļāko. Pēc viņa nāves smagi cieš Čārlija fiziskā un garīgā veselība - vīrietis ir slimīgi aptaukojies un nomākts. Čārlijs nolemj atjaunot sarautās saites ar meitu, pirms nav par vēlu.

programme.title: Slepkavas pēdas
programme.desc: Čikāgas detektīvs Dens Losons (Semjuels L. Džeksons) nespēj izmest no prāta neatrisinātu slepkavību sēriju. Pirms pieciem gadiem tika brutāli nogalināta viņa draudzene, taču slepkavu tā arī neizdevās notvert. Kad Skotijā sāk notikt sieviešu slepkavības ar to pašu nepārprotamo rokrakstu, aizdomas kļūst arvien spēcīgākas – šķiet, ka sadistiskais sērijslepkava atkal uzdarbojas, tikai citā kontinentā. Baidoties no jauniem noziegumiem, Skotijas izmeklētāji lūdz Losona palīdzību, un viņš nekavējoties dodas pāri okeānam. Tur kopā ar detektīvu Volkeru Bravo viņš cenšas beidzot notvert slepkavu, kurš reiz izslīdēja no viņa rokām, pirms tas paspēj uzbrukt atkal.

programme.title: Futbols: Bundesliga. Werder Bremen - Hamburg
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Futbols: LaLiga. Real Madrid - Celta
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Basketbols: Eirolīga. Dubai - Partizan
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Basketbols: Eirolīga. Besiktas - Paris
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch
programme.desc: Rivaling the famous Area 51 in Nevada for UFO sightings and paramormal activity, is the lesser known, but equally fascinating, Uinta Basin in Utah and, in particular, Skinwalker Ranch. For the first time, a team of scientists and experts have been granted unlimited access to the infamous and secretive 512-acre property in order to unlock the mysteries of more than 200 years of UFO activity, bizarre animal mutations and preternatural phenomena. Making good use of state-of-the-art tecnology such as drone thermography, ground-penetrating radar and lasers, the team apply their knowledge and expertise to make shocking discoveries.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Chum hopes for anything but a blue period when he makes a surreal offer on a Salvador Dali lithograph of Pablo Picasso. Then, Rick is ready to make a new deal when a seller brings in recordings of FDR's Fireside Chats. Next, Rick and Chum test out a Civil War primed revolver. Will they find union with the seller, or will they remain divided? And later, Corey pays a visit to the Dark Side when a model of the Death Star hits the counter.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: In a pawn shop far away, Rick and Corey unbox a skateboard signed by Carrie Fisher. Then, Corey has a first-person encounter with "Halo: Combat Evolved." Will he be the Master Chief of this deal? Meanwhile, Chum is stunned by a colorful vintage Versace collection. Is this deal on brand, or out of style? And later, Corey goes crazy when a seller brings in a guitar signed by Aerosmith's Joe Perry. Can he make the guitar walk his way, or will the seller tell him to dream on?

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Project Impossible
programme.desc: Project Impossible is an original series that follows a new generation of epic engineering projects that were considered unthinkable just a few years ago. Each episode of Project Impossible features multiple stories that illustrate man-made projects that are crucial to our future. These projects include a massive North Sea wind station with 600-foot rotors, a giant sea wall that will protect the ancient city of Venice from rising waters, the world's largest moveable structure in Chernobyl, and the construction of a fleet of nuclear powered icebreaking ships.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Warriors goes inside the culture of the most famous warriors of all time to explore their weaponry, tactics, training and, ultimately, their psyche. Every episode tells the dramatic story of one of the world's iconic warrior groups--Vikings, Spartans, Barbarians, Samurai--including the rituals, technology and strategy that made them so mighty. Warriors is hosted by Terry Schappert, a Green Beret and 17-year veteran currently serving in the US Special Forces. He delves deep into the mindset of a warrior, revealing what made these individuals rise above others to lead, to fight and sometimes to die. Each Warriors episode also explores a climactic battle that showcases the warrior's strengths, weaknesses and life-and-death struggle. From Zulus to English Knights to Hawaiians, Terry is fully immersed in the warrior culture--from the weapons used to the pre-battle rituals, to the initiations, to battlefield strategy and tactics. When delving deep into the Viking culture, he experiences first hand the fighting techniques and tests the weapons of the warriors that some call "the Hells Angels" of the Middle Ages. In the Samurai episode, Terry learns the secrets and traditions of the elite and mysterious warriors who for centuries ruled Japan. In English Knights, he dons the armor, uses the weapons and lives the code of chivalry. In every episode of Warriors, Terry talks to experts on each of the warrior cultures, moves beyond the stereotypes and gains new insights about who these men really were. Walking in the footsteps of history's greatest Warriors proves to be a gut-wrenching experience, but it's all part of Terry's amazing journey to discover the heart of a warrior.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Serial Killer Earth
programme.desc: In recent years the destructive power of natural disasters has been recorded, from Hurricane Katrina to the earthquake and tsunami that devastated Japan. Serial Killer Earth brings together a top team of experts to examine the most compelling footage from news and home video, as well as eyewitness testimony, in order to explain, understand and inform viewers of what actually happened during these disasters and how they compare and contrast with the most historic natural disasters of the past.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: An FBI cold case that has laid dormant for 70 years leads a group of world-renown investigators on the ultimate manhunt to finally answer the question: Did Adolf Hitler survive World War II? In early 2014 the FBI declassified hundreds of confidential documents showing that Hitler may have not committed suicide but rather escaped to South America after the fall of Germany. A memo from J. Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." Armed with the most cutting edge technology and these newly released FBI files the team will approach this case like a modern death claims investigation. Whether they are investigating a mysterious Nazi lair deep in the Argentinian jungle or diving for evidence of a missing U-Boat that could of shuttled Hitler to South America our team will focus on the tried and tested tenants for solving a fraudulent death case: follow the money where was the subject last seen, eyewitness reports, make contact with known associates and forensics.With declassified worldwide intelligence providing a wealth of new clues and modern technology never before available we reopen this world famous cold case in hopes of solving the mystery surrounding the demise of one of the biggest criminals of all time.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Across ancient civilizations, the world's mountains were viewed as the sacred home to all-powerful gods. Why would so many different cultures share this belief that mountains had a connection to otherworldly beings? The Greeks believed their most powerful gods, the Olympians, waged an epic war for control of the universe from Mt. Olympus. Ruins of a 4000-year-old observatory discovered on a mountain in Macedonia reveal that the ancients tracked celestial movements from on high with remarkable precision. And in Peru, the descendants of the Incans continue an ancient pilgrimage tradition in order to commune with mountain spirits known as Apu. Could these gods have been extraterrestrials? Did they use remote mountain peaks to interact with early man? Might this explain why humans have been drawn to mountains for thousands of years?

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: Today, New York is the biggest city in the country... but it's got some dark secrets in its past. It was founded by covert groups, overrun with gangs and mob bosses, and ruled by secret societies. This is the true foundation of the city that never sleeps, and host Don Wildman is headed deep beneath the skyscrapers, taxicabs and street vendors into a New York that few have ever seen before. From a hidden Freemason tunnel and secret world of the Sandhogs, to mobster hideaways and gang escape routes, we're uncovering the secret societies that built New York--from the underground up.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. programme.title: Serial Killer Earth
programme.desc: In recent years the destructive power of natural disasters has been recorded, from Hurricane Katrina to the earthquake and tsunami that devastated Japan. Serial Killer Earth brings together a top team of experts to examine the most compelling footage from news and home video, as well as eyewitness testimony, in order to explain, understand and inform viewers of what actually happened during these disasters and how they compare and contrast with the most historic natural disasters of the past.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: An FBI cold case that has laid dormant for 70 years leads a group of world-renown investigators on the ultimate manhunt to finally answer the question: Did Adolf Hitler survive World War II? Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." Armed with the most cutting edge technology and these newly released FBI files the team will approach this case like a modern death claims investigation. Whether they are investigating a mysterious Nazi lair deep in the Argentinian jungle or diving for evidence of a missing U-Boat that could of shuttled Hitler to South America our team will focus on the tried and tested tenants for solving a fraudulent death case: follow the money where was the subject last seen, eyewitness reports, make contact with known associates and forensics.With declassified worldwide intelligence providing a wealth of new clues and modern technology never before available we reopen this world famous cold case in hopes of solving the mystery surrounding the demise of one of the biggest criminals of all time.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Across ancient civilizations, the world's mountains were viewed as the sacred home to all-powerful gods. Why would so many different cultures share this belief that mountains had a connection to otherworldly beings? The Greeks believed their most powerful gods, the Olympians, waged an epic war for control of the universe from Mt. Olympus. Ruins of a 4000-year-old observatory discovered on a mountain in Macedonia reveal that the ancients tracked celestial movements from on high with remarkable precision. And in Peru, the descendants of the Incans continue an ancient pilgrimage tradition in order to commune with mountain spirits known as Apu. Could these gods have been extraterrestrials? Did they use remote mountain peaks to interact with early man? Might this explain why humans have been drawn to mountains for thousands of years?

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: Today, New York is the biggest city in the country... but it's got some dark secrets in its past. It was founded by covert groups, overrun with gangs and mob bosses, and ruled by secret societies. This is the true foundation of the city that never sleeps, and host Don Wildman is headed deep beneath the skyscrapers, taxicabs and street vendors into a New York that few have ever seen before. From a hidden Freemason tunnel and secret world of the Sandhogs, to mobster hideaways and gang escape routes, we're uncovering the secret societies that built New York--from the underground up.

programme.title: Project Impossible
programme.desc: Project Impossible is an original series that follows a new generation of epic engineering projects that were considered unthinkable just a few years ago. Each episode of Project Impossible features multiple stories that illustrate man-made projects that are crucial to our future. These projects include a massive North Sea wind station with 600-foot rotors, a giant sea wall that will protect the ancient city of Venice from rising waters, the world's largest moveable structure in Chernobyl, and the construction of a fleet of nuclear powered icebreaking ships.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Warriors goes inside the culture of the most famous warriors of all time to explore their weaponry, tactics, training and, ultimately, their psyche. Every episode tells the dramatic story of one of the world's iconic warrior groups--Vikings, Spartans, Barbarians, Samurai--including the rituals, technology and strategy that made them so mighty. Warriors is hosted by Terry Schappert, a Green Beret and 17-year veteran currently serving in the US Special Forces. He delves deep into the mindset of a warrior, revealing what made these individuals rise above others to lead, to fight and sometimes to die. Each Warriors episode also explores a climactic battle that showcases the warrior's strengths, weaknesses and life-and-death struggle. From Zulus to English Knights to Hawaiians, Terry is fully immersed in the warrior culture--from the weapons used to the pre-battle rituals, to the initiations, to battlefield strategy and tactics. When delving deep into the Viking culture, he experiences first hand the fighting techniques and tests the weapons of the warriors that some call "the Hells Angels" of the Middle Ages. In the Samurai episode, Terry learns the secrets and traditions of the elite and mysterious warriors who for centuries ruled Japan. In English Knights, he dons the armor, uses the weapons and lives the code of chivalry. In every episode of Warriors, Terry talks to experts on each of the warrior cultures, moves beyond the stereotypes and gains new insights about who these men really were. Walking in the footsteps of history's greatest Warriors proves to be a gut-wrenching experience, but it's all part of Terry's amazing journey to discover the heart of a warrior.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Strange rock carvings from 8,000 B.C. Unexplained sightings in the new world. And a frightening anomaly plaguing the American West. Is there more to America's past than is found in our history books? Could the mysterious stories and relics found throughout the United States be evidence of extraterrestrial contact in the distant past? In 1909, the Phoenix Gazette reported the finding of a strange man-made cave filled with ancient objects and mummies. Could there be a connection between the mysterious cave and the legend of Native American ancestors called "Star Beings?" Strange lights and unexplained weather anomalies were documented throughout colonial America. Is there evidence that early American settlers had close encounters with extraterrestrial entities? Could UFO sightings and reports of alien contact be part of America's untold history?

programme.title: When Big Things Go Wrong
programme.desc: Modern technology allows us to build incredible structures like giant tankers, mammoth skyscrapers and colossal bridges. But, with enormous size comes enormous risk, and when big things go wrong, they go really wrong. The HISTORY Channel's new series examines the catastrophic result of some of the world's worst engineering disasters caught on tape. Each episode breaks down shocking footage from collapses and collisions to reveal the shocking answers to the question, what happened? Woven together through innovative graphics, eyewitness accounts and expert knowledge, the series unravels the mystery behind these destructive moments and their lasting worldwide impact.

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: Why did a 72 oil-car runaway train crash, killing 47 people and leveling half a town? Was it the brakes? Also, can engineers do anything to fix a gaping sinkhole at the National Corvette Museum, so car enthusiasts can safely return? And, what caused the Minneapolis Metrodome's iconic roof to collapse? Was it an engineering flaw or Mother Nature? Football fans want to know. Then, as 33 Chilean miners await their ultimate fate, trapped almost a half mile underground, mine drilling engineers scramble to dig a hole big enough to rescue them. Can a special drill make it though through earth harder than granite? And finally, JetBlue flight 194 started out like any other for 149 passengers. But just minutes into the journey, the airplane is almost crippled by a sudden hydraulic failure.
